main.description: The public announcement of a secret poll whose board is public, written by the board account (`docs/ballot-board-custody.md`): the question, the options, the ballot rules, the per-poll issuer key and the custody key, out before any ballot is, since every ballot names this record. Only a poll opened as public has one: a closed group's votes, and a hidden tally, are not the world's. The roster, delegations, weights and issuance stay private and are never records. Its lifecycle is the one field `state`, open then closed, on this one record; any other change after creation is tamper-evident in the record's history, and a mirror raises an alarm for it.

options.description: The choices, in ballot order. When blank is true the LAST element is the trailing Blank abstention (excluded from winning).

state.description: Open, then closed. A ballot counts only if it was cast while open.

closingAuthority.description: The board account's DID, which is what moves `state` to closed.

issuerPubkey.description: The poll's RSA issuer public key, DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo as base64url without padding (`crates/ballot-spec`, D6 and D7). Per-poll keys are what binds a token to its poll: blinding hides the message from the issuer.

minVote.description: Minimum selections for a non-blank ballot. A lone blank abstention bypasses this minimum.

blank.description: Whether the last element of options is the trailing Blank abstention: valid only alone on a ballot, excluded from winning in the tally.

openAt.description: When the poll opens (state moves to open). Resolved weights are frozen at this instant.

closesAt.description: Optional: the scheduled close. Closure still requires the closingAuthority's state transition.

pollId.description: The poll's id at the AppView, which is what its receipts and its close-out are signed over.

custodyKey.description: The `did:key` (P-256) that signs this poll's receipts and its close-out. Kept for nothing else, and not the issuer key.
